source.label: EU AI Act consolidated 27 July 2026
source.description: Dated consolidated text of Regulation (EU) 2024/1689; documentation aid rather than authentic Official Journal publication.

classes.label: Actor role
classes.description: Role named by the Act.

classes.label: Member State
classes.description: Member State as the actor responsible for designating authorities.

classes.label: Provider
classes.description: Provider role as named in the Act.

classes.label: Deployer
classes.description: Deployer role as named in the Act.

classes.label: National competent authority
classes.description: National competent authority role as named in the Act.

classes.label: Market surveillance authority
classes.description: Market surveillance authority role as named in the Act.

classes.label: AI system
classes.description: Machine-based system as defined by Article 3(1).

classes.label: High-risk AI system
classes.description: A system meeting an Article 6 classification route, subject to applicable conditions and exceptions.

classes.label: Annex I product-related AI system
classes.description: AI system in the Annex I product-related route; further Article 6(1) conditions determine high-risk status.

classes.label: Annex III listed AI system
classes.description: AI system in an Annex III listed use case; Article 6(3) may exclude high-risk status.

classes.label: Annex III: Biometrics
classes.description: AI systems in the specified Annex III use cases for biometrics; this does not classify every system in the sector as high-risk.

classes.label: Annex III: Critical infrastructure
classes.description: AI systems in the specified Annex III use cases for critical infrastructure; this does not classify every system in the sector as high-risk.

classes.label: Annex III: Education and vocational training
classes.description: AI systems in the specified Annex III use cases for education and vocational training; this does not classify every system in the sector as high-risk.

classes.label: Annex III: Employment and workers management
classes.description: AI systems in the specified Annex III use cases for employment and workers management; this does not classify every system in the sector as high-risk.

classes.label: Annex III: Essential private and public services
classes.description: AI systems in the specified Annex III use cases for essential private and public services; this does not classify every system in the sector as high-risk.

classes.label: Annex III: Law enforcement
classes.description: AI systems in the specified Annex III use cases for law enforcement; this does not classify every system in the sector as high-risk.

classes.label: Annex III: Migration, asylum and border control
classes.description: AI systems in the specified Annex III use cases for migration, asylum and border control; this does not classify every system in the sector as high-risk.

classes.label: Annex III: Administration of justice and democratic processes
classes.description: AI systems in the specified Annex III use cases for administration of justice and democratic processes; this does not classify every system in the sector as high-risk.

classes.label: Direct-interaction AI system
classes.description: System intended to interact directly with natural persons.

classes.label: Synthetic-content AI system
classes.description: System generating synthetic audio, image, video or text content.

classes.label: Emotion-recognition AI system
classes.description: Emotion-recognition system subject to transparency rules.

classes.label: Deep-fake AI system
classes.description: System generating or manipulating image, audio or video content constituting a deep fake.

classes.label: General-purpose AI model
classes.description: General-purpose AI model as addressed in Chapter V.

classes.label: AI practice
classes.description: Use, placement or putting into service of an AI system as described in Article 5.

classes.label: Article 5-listed practice
classes.description: A practice described in Article 5(1); whether the prohibition applies depends on the cited statement, conditions and exceptions.

classes.label: Manipulative or deceptive technique
classes.description: Article 5(1) point (a) practice, subject to its stated scope and exceptions.

classes.label: Exploitation of vulnerabilities
classes.description: Article 5(1) point (b) practice, subject to its stated scope and exceptions.

classes.label: Non-consensual intimate or sexual content
classes.description: Article 5(1) point (ba) practice, subject to its stated scope and exceptions.

classes.label: Child sexual abuse material or performance
classes.description: Article 5(1) point (bb) practice, subject to its stated scope and exceptions.

classes.label: Social scoring
classes.description: Article 5(1) point (c) practice, subject to its stated scope and exceptions.

classes.label: Crime risk assessment based solely on profiling
classes.description: Article 5(1) point (d) practice, subject to its stated scope and exceptions.

classes.label: Untargeted facial-image scraping
classes.description: Article 5(1) point (e) practice, subject to its stated scope and exceptions.

classes.label: Workplace or education emotion inference
classes.description: Article 5(1) point (f) practice, subject to its stated scope and exceptions.

classes.label: Sensitive biometric categorisation
classes.description: Article 5(1) point (g) practice, subject to its stated scope and exceptions.

classes.label: Real-time remote biometric identification in public spaces for law enforcement
classes.description: Article 5(1)(h) practice of using real-time remote biometric identification in publicly accessible spaces for law enforcement, subject to stated objectives and safeguards.

classes.label: Legal statement
classes.description: Cited statement of classification, obligation or prohibition.

classes.description: Obligation recorded as an individual with a source provision.

classes.label: Prohibition
classes.description: Prohibition recorded as an individual with a source provision.

classes.label: Classification rule
classes.description: Classification rule recorded as an individual with a source provision.

classes.label: Legal provision

statements.label: Ensure high-risk AI systems are compliant with the requirements set out in Section 2
statements.description: Ensure high-risk AI systems are compliant with the requirements set out in Section 2
statements.evidence: ensure that their high-risk AI systems are compliant with the requirements set out in Section 2

statements.label: Indicate provider name, trade name/trademark, and contact address on the system or packaging/documentation
statements.description: Indicate provider name, trade name/trademark, and contact address on the system or packaging/documentation
statements.evidence: indicate on the high-risk AI system or, where that is not possible, on its packaging or its accompanying documentation
statements.condition: Where indication on the system is not possible, on its packaging or accompanying documentation

statements.label: Have a quality management system in place which complies with Article 17
statements.description: Have a quality management system in place which complies with Article 17
statements.evidence: have a quality management system in place which complies with Article 17

statements.label: Keep the documentation referred to in Article 18
statements.description: Keep the documentation referred to in Article 18
statements.evidence: keep the documentation referred to in Article 18

statements.label: Keep the logs automatically generated by the high-risk AI system as referred to in Article 19
statements.description: Keep the logs automatically generated by the high-risk AI system as referred to in Article 19
statements.evidence: when under their control, keep the logs automatically generated by their high-risk AI systems
statements.condition: when under their control

statements.label: Ensure the system undergoes the relevant conformity assessment procedure per Article 43 before placement on market
statements.description: Ensure the system undergoes the relevant conformity assessment procedure per Article 43 before placement on market
statements.evidence: ensure that the high-risk AI system undergoes the relevant conformity assessment procedure as referred to in Article 43
statements.condition: prior to its being placed on the market or put into service

statements.label: Draw up an EU declaration of conformity in accordance with Article 47
statements.description: Draw up an EU declaration of conformity in accordance with Article 47
statements.evidence: draw up an EU declaration of conformity in accordance with Article 47

statements.label: Affix the CE marking to indicate conformity with this Regulation in accordance with Article 48
statements.description: Affix the CE marking to indicate conformity with this Regulation in accordance with Article 48
statements.evidence: affix the CE marking to the high-risk AI system or, where that is not possible, on its packaging
statements.condition: Where affixing on the system is not possible, on its packaging or accompanying documentation

statements.label: Comply with the registration obligations referred to in Article 49(1)
statements.description: Comply with the registration obligations referred to in Article 49(1)
statements.evidence: comply with the registration obligations referred to in Article 49(1)

statements.label: Take necessary corrective actions and provide information as required in Article 20
statements.description: Take necessary corrective actions and provide information as required in Article 20
statements.evidence: take the necessary corrective actions and provide information as required in Article 20

statements.label: Demonstrate conformity of the system with Section 2 requirements upon reasoned request of a national competent authority
statements.description: Demonstrate conformity of the system with Section 2 requirements upon reasoned request of a national competent authority
statements.evidence: upon a reasoned request of a national competent authority, demonstrate the conformity of the high-risk AI system
statements.condition: upon a reasoned request of a national competent authority

statements.label: Ensure the system complies with accessibility requirements per Directives (EU) 2016/2102 and (EU) 2019/882
statements.description: Ensure the system complies with accessibility requirements per Directives (EU) 2016/2102 and (EU) 2019/882
statements.evidence: ensure that the high-risk AI system complies with accessibility requirements in accordance with Directives (EU) 2016/2102

statements.label: Take technical and organisational measures to use the system in accordance with its instructions for use.
statements.description: Take technical and organisational measures to use the system in accordance with its instructions for use.
statements.evidence: take appropriate technical and organisational measures to ensure they use such systems in accordance with the instructions for use
statements.condition: pursuant to paragraphs 3 and 6

statements.label: Assign human oversight to natural persons with the necessary competence, training, authority, and support.
statements.description: Assign human oversight to natural persons with the necessary competence, training, authority, and support.
statements.evidence: assign human oversight to natural persons who have the necessary competence, training and authority

statements.label: Ensure input data is relevant and sufficiently representative for the intended purpose of the system.
statements.description: Ensure input data is relevant and sufficiently representative for the intended purpose of the system.
statements.evidence: ensure that input data is relevant and sufficiently representative in view of the intended purpose
statements.condition: to the extent the deployer exercises control over the input data

statements.label: Monitor the operation of the system based on its instructions for use and inform providers where relevant.
statements.description: Monitor the operation of the system based on its instructions for use and inform providers where relevant.
statements.evidence: monitor the operation of the high-risk AI system on the basis of the instructions for use
statements.exception: shall not cover sensitive operational data of deployers of AI systems which are law enforcement authorities

statements.label: Keep automatically generated logs for at least six months, to the extent they are under the deployer's control.
statements.description: Keep automatically generated logs for at least six months, to the extent they are under the deployer's control.
statements.evidence: keep the logs automatically generated by that high-risk AI system to the extent such logs are under their control
statements.condition: Logs are under the deployer’s control; retention is for a period appropriate to the system’s intended purpose, of at least six months.
statements.exception: unless provided otherwise in applicable Union or national law, in particular in Union law on the protection of personal data

statements.label: Inform workers' representatives and affected workers before putting into service or using a high-risk AI system at the workplace.
statements.description: Inform workers' representatives and affected workers before putting into service or using a high-risk AI system at the workplace.
statements.evidence: that they will be subject to the use of the high-risk AI system
statements.condition: Before putting into service or using a high-risk AI system at the workplace

statements.label: Inform natural persons that they are subject to the use of the high-risk AI system.
statements.description: Inform natural persons that they are subject to the use of the high-risk AI system.
statements.evidence: shall inform the natural persons that they are subject to the use of the high-risk AI system
statements.condition: deployers of high-risk AI systems referred to in Annex III that make decisions or assist in making decisions related to natural persons

statements.label: Draw up and keep up-to-date technical documentation containing, at minimum, the Annex XI information, to provide upon request to the AI Office and national competent authorities.
statements.description: Draw up and keep up-to-date technical documentation containing, at minimum, the Annex XI information, to provide upon request to the AI Office and national competent authorities.
statements.evidence: draw up and keep up-to-date the technical documentation of the model
statements.condition: shall contain, at a minimum, the information set out in Annex XI; for the purpose of providing it, upon request, to the AI Office and the national competent authorities
statements.exception: Not applicable to models released under a free and open-source licence with publicly available parameters, weights, architecture and usage information; does not apply to models with systemic risks (Article 53(2))

statements.label: Draw up, keep up-to-date and make available information and documentation enabling downstream providers to understand capabilities and limitations and to comply, containing at minimum the Annex XII elements.
statements.description: Draw up, keep up-to-date and make available information and documentation enabling downstream providers to understand capabilities and limitations and to comply, containing at minimum the Annex XII elements.
statements.evidence: draw up, keep up-to-date and make available information
statements.condition: without prejudice to intellectual property rights and confidential business information or trade secrets in accordance with Union and national law; shall enable good understanding of capabilities and limitations and compliance, and contain, at a minimum, the elements set out in Annex XII
statements.exception: Not applicable to models released under a free and open-source licence with publicly available parameters, weights, architecture and usage information; does not apply to models with systemic risks (Article 53(2))

statements.label: Put in place a policy to comply with Union copyright law, in particular to identify and comply with reservations of rights under Article 4(3) of Directive (EU) 2019/790.
statements.description: Put in place a policy to comply with Union copyright law, in particular to identify and comply with reservations of rights under Article 4(3) of Directive (EU) 2019/790.
statements.evidence: put in place a policy to comply with Union law on copyright and related rights
statements.condition: in particular to identify and comply with, including through state-of-the-art technologies, a reservation of rights expressed pursuant to Article 4(3) of Directive (EU) 2019/790

statements.label: Draw up and make publicly available a sufficiently detailed summary of the content used to train the model, following an AI Office template.
statements.description: Draw up and make publicly available a sufficiently detailed summary of the content used to train the model, following an AI Office template.
statements.evidence: draw up and make publicly available a sufficiently detailed summary about the content used for training
statements.condition: according to a template provided by the AI Office

statements.label: Inform natural persons they are interacting with an AI system, unless obvious to a reasonably well-informed, observant and circumspect person in the circumstances and context of use.
statements.description: Inform natural persons they are interacting with an AI system, unless obvious to a reasonably well-informed, observant and circumspect person in the circumstances and context of use.
statements.evidence: the natural persons concerned are informed that they are interacting with an AI system
statements.condition: unless this is obvious from the point of view of a natural person who is reasonably well-informed, observant and circumspect, taking into account the circumstances and the context of use
statements.exception: Shall not apply to AI systems authorised by law to detect, prevent, investigate or prosecute criminal offences, subject to appropriate safeguards for the rights and freedoms of third parties, unless those systems are available for the public to report a criminal offence.

statements.label: Mark outputs in machine-readable format and detectable as artificially generated or manipulated; technical solutions must be effective, interoperable, robust and reliable as far as technically feasible given content type, cost, and state of the art.
statements.description: Mark outputs in machine-readable format and detectable as artificially generated or manipulated; technical solutions must be effective, interoperable, robust and reliable as far as technically feasible given content type, cost, and state of the art.
statements.evidence: the outputs of the AI system are marked in a machine-readable format and detectable as artificially generated or manipulated
statements.condition: effective, interoperable, robust and reliable as far as this is technically feasible, taking into account the specificities and limitations of various types of content, the costs of implementation and the generally acknowledged state of the art
statements.exception: Shall not apply to the extent the AI systems perform an assistive function for standard editing or do not substantially alter the input data provided by the deployer or the semantics thereof, or where authorised by law to detect, prevent, investigate or prosecute criminal offences.

statements.label: Inform natural persons exposed to the operation of the system and process personal data in accordance with applicable EU data protection law.
statements.description: Inform natural persons exposed to the operation of the system and process personal data in accordance with applicable EU data protection law.
statements.evidence: shall inform the natural persons exposed thereto of the operation of the system
statements.condition: shall process the personal data in accordance with Regulations (EU) 2016/679 and (EU) 2018/1725 and Directive (EU) 2016/680, as applicable
statements.exception: Shall not apply to AI systems used for biometric categorisation and emotion recognition, which are permitted by law to detect, prevent or investigate criminal offences, subject to appropriate safeguards for the rights and freedoms of third parties, and in accordance with Union law.

statements.label: Disclose that the content has been artificially generated or manipulated. For artistic, creative, satirical, fictional or analogous works, limited to disclosure of existence in an appropriate manner not hampering display or enjoyment.
statements.description: Disclose that the content has been artificially generated or manipulated. For artistic, creative, satirical, fictional or analogous works, limited to disclosure of existence in an appropriate manner not hampering display or enjoyment.
statements.evidence: shall disclose that the content has been artificially generated or manipulated
statements.exception: Shall not apply where the use is authorised by law to detect, prevent, investigate or prosecute criminal offence. For evidently artistic, creative, satirical, fictional or analogous work or programme, limited to disclosure of the existence of such generated or manipulated content in an appropriate manner that does not hamper the display or enjoyment of the work.

statements.label: Disclose that the text has been artificially generated or manipulated.
statements.description: Disclose that the text has been artificially generated or manipulated.
statements.evidence: shall disclose that the text has been artificially generated or manipulated
statements.condition: published with the purpose of informing the public on matters of public interest
statements.exception: Shall not apply where the use is authorised by law to detect, prevent, investigate or prosecute criminal offences or where the AI-generated content has undergone a process of human review or editorial control and where a natural or legal person holds editorial responsibility for the publication of the content.

statements.label: Annex I product route to high-risk classification
statements.description: Annex I product route to high-risk classification
statements.evidence: that AI system shall be considered to be high-risk where both of the following conditions are fulfilled
statements.condition: Both safety-component/product coverage by Annex I legislation and required third-party conformity assessment.
statements.exception: Article 6(1a) excludes solely non-safety uses, Article 6(1b) restores safety-component status where failure would endanger health or safety, and Article 6(1c) excludes third-party assessment solely for non-health-and-safety risks.

statements.label: Annex III listed route to high-risk classification
statements.description: Annex III listed route to high-risk classification
statements.evidence: AI systems referred to in Annex III shall be considered to be high-risk
statements.condition: The system is in an Annex III listed use case.
statements.exception: Article 6(3) derogation may apply to non-profiling systems; a provider invoking it must document the assessment and comply with Article 49(2) registration under Article 6(4).

statements.label: Annex III derogation from high-risk classification
statements.description: Annex III derogation from high-risk classification
statements.evidence: an AI system referred to in Annex III shall not be considered to be high-risk where it does not pose a significant risk
statements.condition: No significant risk of harm and at least one listed Article 6(3)(a)–(d) circumstance.
statements.exception: An Annex III system that performs profiling of natural persons is always high-risk.

statements.label: Subliminal, manipulative or deceptive techniques materially distorting behaviour causing significant harm
statements.description: Subliminal, manipulative or deceptive techniques materially distorting behaviour causing significant harm
statements.evidence: the placing on the market, the putting into service or the use of an AI system that deploys subliminal techniques beyond a person's consciousness
statements.condition: Materially distorts behaviour and causes or is reasonably likely to cause significant harm.

statements.label: Exploiting vulnerabilities of a person or group due to age, disability or social/economic situation
statements.description: Exploiting vulnerabilities of a person or group due to age, disability or social/economic situation
statements.evidence: exploits any of the vulnerabilities of a natural person or a specific group of persons due to their age, disability
statements.condition: Materially distorts behaviour and causes or is reasonably likely to cause significant harm.

statements.label: Generation or manipulation of intimate or sexually explicit material of an identifiable person
statements.description: Generation or manipulation of intimate or sexually explicit material of an identifiable person
statements.evidence: generates or manipulates realistic images, videos, audio or similar material of an identifiable natural person's intimate parts
statements.condition: Applies where done without that person's freely-given, specific, informed, unambiguous and explicit consent for that generation or manipulation. Article 5(1a) limits placement, service and use; Article 5(1b) limits manipulation.

statements.label: Generation or manipulation of material within the meaning of Article 2(c) and (e) of Directive 2011/93/EU
statements.description: Generation or manipulation of material within the meaning of Article 2(c) and (e) of Directive 2011/93/EU
statements.evidence: an AI system that generates or manipulates material or performance within the meaning of Article 2, points (c) and (e), of Directive 2011/93/EU
statements.exception: Except where a 'without right' defence applies under national law. Article 5(1a) further limits placement, service and use.

statements.label: Social scoring (evaluation/classification of persons or groups over time) leading to detrimental or unfavourable treatment
statements.description: Social scoring (evaluation/classification of persons or groups over time) leading to detrimental or unfavourable treatment
statements.evidence: AI systems for the evaluation or classification of natural persons or groups of persons over a certain period of time based on their social behaviour
statements.condition: Applies where the social score leads to detrimental or unfavourable treatment in contexts unrelated to where the data was collected, or that is unjustified or disproportionate to the behaviour or its gravity.

statements.label: Predictive risk assessment of a person committing a criminal offence based solely on profiling or personality traits
statements.description: Predictive risk assessment of a person committing a criminal offence based solely on profiling or personality traits
statements.evidence: to assess or predict the risk of a natural person committing a criminal offence, based solely on the profiling of a natural person
statements.exception: Shall not apply to AI systems used to support the human assessment of a person's involvement in criminal activity already based on objective and verifiable facts directly linked to a criminal activity.

statements.label: Untargeted facial-image scraping
statements.description: Untargeted facial-image scraping
statements.evidence: untargeted scraping of facial images from the internet or CCTV footage

statements.label: Workplace or education emotion inference
statements.description: Workplace or education emotion inference
statements.evidence: to infer emotions of a natural person in the areas of workplace and education institutions

statements.label: Sensitive biometric categorisation
statements.description: Sensitive biometric categorisation
statements.evidence: to deduce or infer their race, political opinions, trade union membership
statements.exception: Lawfully acquired biometric dataset labelling/filtering and law-enforcement biometric categorisation are excluded.

statements.label: Real-time remote biometric identification in public spaces for law enforcement
statements.description: Article 5(1)(h) prohibition on use in publicly accessible spaces for law enforcement, subject to strictly necessary objectives and further safeguards.
statements.evidence: the use of ‘real-time’ remote biometric identification systems in publicly accessible spaces
statements.condition: Use in publicly accessible spaces for law-enforcement purposes.
statements.exception: Use may be permitted only insofar as strictly necessary for an Article 5(1)(h)(i)–(iii) objective, with the Article 5(2)–(5) safeguards and authorisation rules, including national law and limited urgency provisions.

statements.label: Member States designate national competent authorities
statements.description: Member States establish or designate at least one notifying authority and at least one market surveillance authority.
statements.evidence: Each Member State shall establish or designate as national competent authorities
